en.title: SNG vs MTT at NUTS: Which Format to Choose — Nuts PPPoker
en.description: SNG and MTT in poker: differences, bankroll, time and profitability. Which tournament format to pick at NUTS club on PPPoker.
en.bodyHtml:
Author: Roman Shaposhnikov

Published: March 2027

SNG or MTT? Both live in PPPoker tournaments — but need different bankroll, time and mindset. Here is what fits NUTS players.

SNG vs MTT

  • SNG — 30–90 min, 50–80 ABI, lower variance
  • MTT — 2–8+ hours, 100+ ABI, overlays and GTD
